title: Website Self-Healer
description: Audit an explicitly supplied application, reproduce defects, apply focused source repairs and preserve verification evidence. No remote writes or deployments are implied.
goal_template: Audit $target_url using source rooted at $source_path. Exercise $critical_journeys with HTTP/DOM checks and a real browser when available. Reproduce each failure, propose root-cause hypotheses, patch source locally with approval, run a bounded three-repair loop, and produce before/after verification evidence. Do not push, deploy, alter acceptance tests, or claim unavailable browser coverage.

parameters.label: Target application URL
parameters.description: An application you operate; loopback is supported by QA.

parameters.label: Workspace source path
parameters.description: Source must already be present in the mission workspace.

parameters.label: Critical journeys
parameters.description: Concrete pages and outcomes to verify.
parameters.default: homepage readiness, navigation, form validation and accessible headings

tasks.title: Establish audit scope
tasks.description: Inspect supplied workspace documentation for $source_path and research public testing guidance. Do not scrape a loopback target through the public researcher; QA probes $target_url.

tasks.title: Add reproducible acceptance checks
tasks.description: Inspect existing source at $source_path. Preserve behavior and write failing regression cases for $critical_journeys. Configure QA for $target_url or a workspace ASGI app. Stop visibly if source is unavailable.

tasks.title: Audit, diagnose and repair
tasks.description: Probe $target_url for $critical_journeys, collect DOM/HTTP evidence and reproduce bugs. Request engineering patches only for workspace source, preserve tests and retry at most three times.

tasks.title: Package verification evidence
tasks.description: Summarize recorded before/after checks, bounded repairs and remaining limitations. Write reviewable documentation and draft change announcements without publishing.

acceptance_criteria: Target URL and source availability are explicit.
Missing source blocks repair rather than inventing a codebase.
Existing acceptance tests and configuration remain protected.
Repair loop never exceeds three iterations.
A failed final check leaves a failed mission with diagnostic artifacts.
